name: dark-factory
description: The dark factory for Claude Code: fences, a quota guard and a merge transaction for agent-driven development.

plugins.name: dark-factory
plugins.description: Guardrails for Claude Code agents on GitHub, for a solo developer or a small studio, held by hooks rather than CLAUDE.md requests: no force push, no push to main, no hook bypass, merges only on green CI through one script, a subscription quota guard that saves work before the limit. Silent until a project opts in with /dark-factory:init; /dark-factory:add grows it into a full delivery pipeline (specs, review, release of accepted work, On-call, a server of projects). Requires python3 3.11+ and git; gh and jq for merges.
